title: AI行业结构性变化信号分析
core_insight: 今日新增的AI信息显示，技术层面上有多项创新，包括GraphDC、CASCADE等新模型和方法的提出，基础设施层面上也有一些进展，如RateQuant和LKV等新技术的出现，应用层面上AI进入了新的行业和场景，如医疗、法律和教育等，资本信号上有多家公司获得融资，风险信号上监管和伦理问题仍然存在

dimension_texts.technology: GraphDC和CASCADE等新模型的提出，推进了LLM的能力边界 CASCADE等新模型的提出，代表了新的范式 GraphDC: A Divide-and-Conquer Multi-Agent System for Scalable Graph Algorithm Reasoning CASCADE: Case-Based Continual Adaptation for Large Language Models During Deployment
dimension_texts.infrastructure: RateQuant和LKV等新技术的出现，降低了推理成本 芯片和算力趋势继续向好 RateQuant: Optimal Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization via Rate-Distortion Theory LKV: End-to-End Learning of Head-wise Budgets and Token Selection for LLM KV Cache Eviction
dimension_texts.application: AI进入了新的行业和场景，如医疗、法律和教育等 AI开始替代传统的解决方案 How ChatGPT adoption broadened in early 2026 OpenAI launches DeployCo to help businesses build around intelligence
dimension_texts.capital: 多家公司获得融资，资本市场对AI的关注度继续提高 估值水平继续上涨 大厂战略投资和收购继续活跃 There aren’t enough rockets for space data centers — Cowboy Space raised $275M to build them Voice AI in India is hard — Wispr Flow is betting on it anyway
dimension_texts.risk: 监管问题仍然存在，需要继续关注 伦理和安全问题仍然存在，需要继续关注 供应链和地缘风险仍然存在，需要继续关注 MELD: Multi-Task Equilibrated Learning Detector for AI-Generated Text Can LLMs Take Retrieved Information with a Grain of Salt?
